The '''Onatos system''' was located in the [[Onatos sector/Legends|Onatos sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="Slice" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Onatos [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which placed it in grid square R-15.<ref name="EAOC" />
